transferableSkills: Mission planning and execution under pressure

civilianMatches.title: General and Operations Managers
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Infantry officers directly transfer command and control skills, planning under uncertainty, and leading diverse teams to operations management roles.

civilianMatches.title: Management Analysts
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Military planning and AAR methodology map directly to process improvement and organizational consulting.

civilianMatches.title: Training and Development Managers
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Military training doctrine and instruction experience translates directly to civilian training program leadership.

credentialGaps.why: Civilian employers often require formal PM certification for roles that parallel military planning experience.
Military experience is broad but civilian employers often want domain expertise.
Accelerates path to senior leadership in civilian organizations, though not required.

resumeSuggestions: Replace 'Commanded 120-soldier infantry company' with 'Led cross-functional team of 120 personnel across operations, logistics, training, and support functions'
Replace 'Executed combat operations in austere environments' with 'Managed high-stakes operations under time pressure with incomplete information, maintaining 94% mission completion rate'
Replace 'MDMP planning' with 'Structured decision-making and operational planning methodology applied to complex, time-sensitive problems'
Replace rank titles with civilian equivalents: Company Commander = Director or Senior Manager; Battalion Commander = Vice President or Senior Director

civilianMatches.title: Network and Computer Systems Administrators
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Direct skill transfer in network management, systems configuration, and infrastructure support.

civilianMatches.title: Information Security Analysts
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Security clearance + military OPSEC and cybersecurity fundamentals are highly valued. Fastest-growing IT specialty.

civilianMatches.title: Computer User Support Specialists
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Entry-level civilian pathway. Better to use as a stepping stone than a destination.

credentialGaps.why: DoD 8570 baseline requirement already familiar. Civilian employers recognize it as IT security baseline.
Formalizes existing networking knowledge for civilian hiring managers.
Cloud infrastructure is where the market is moving. Essential for future-proofing.

resumeSuggestions: Replace 'Maintained SIPR/NIPR network' with 'Administered classified and unclassified enterprise networks supporting 500+ end users'
Replace 'Performed PMCS on IT equipment' with 'Managed lifecycle maintenance and asset tracking for enterprise IT infrastructure'
Highlight active security clearance prominently: 'Active TS/SCI clearance' is a significant competitive advantage in the civilian market
Quantify: number of users supported, uptime percentage, ticket volume, response time

transferableSkills: Training and instruction of non-medical personnel

civilianMatches.title: Emergency Medical Technicians
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Direct skill transfer. Most states accept military medical training toward EMT or paramedic licensure.

civilianMatches.title: Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses
civilianMatches.whyItFits: With additional civilian licensure, 68Ws have a strong pathway into LPN/LVN roles.

civilianMatches.title: Registered Nurses
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Longer credentialing path but strong long-term outcome. Military medical experience gives you a head start on clinical thinking.

credentialGaps.why: Required to practice. Many states have military reciprocity programs.
Nationally portable credential that reduces state-by-state relicensure.
Unlocks higher pay and more career options. Military training may count toward credit hours.

resumeSuggestions: Replace 'Performed TCCC on simulated casualties' with 'Provided emergency trauma care under time-critical conditions, including hemorrhage control, airway management, and casualty stabilization'
Replace 'Maintained medical supplies IAW SOP' with 'Managed pharmaceutical and medical equipment inventory, ensuring 100% supply readiness for 500-person unit'
Replace 'Trained soldiers on first aid' with 'Developed and delivered emergency medical training curriculum to 120+ personnel; maintained unit qualification rates above 98%'

transferableSkills: Compliance with health and safety regulations

civilianMatches.title: Food Service Managers
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Direct operations management transfer from DFAC management to civilian food service leadership.

civilianMatches.title: Lodging Managers
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Military lodging management experience maps directly to hotel or hospitality management.

civilianMatches.title: Meeting, Convention, and Event Planners
civilianMatches.whyItFits: Military event coordination and protocol experience transfers to civilian event management.

credentialGaps.why: Industry standard for food service management. Quick to obtain and widely recognized.
AHLEI credential that formalizes supervisory experience for hospitality employers.

resumeSuggestions: Replace 'Managed DFAC operations' with 'Directed food service operations serving 2,000+ daily meals, managing staff scheduling, inventory, and quality compliance'
Replace 'Performed billeting duties' with 'Managed lodging operations for 200-room facility, overseeing reservations, housekeeping standards, and guest services'
